newsitem.title: USA: Federated warns Nov-Dec sales will moderate.
newsitem.headline: Federated warns Nov-Dec sales will moderate.

text.p: Federated Department Stores, Inc said Thursday that November and December would together not show as much of a sales rise as Novemer. Earlier, the company reported total sales of $1,552.3 million for the four weeks ended November 30, 1996, an increase of 3.8 percent from total sales of $1,495.4 million for the same four-week period last year.

On a comparable-store basis, Federated's November 1996 sales increased 9.6 percent. It added that November 1995 total sales reflect revenue from all of the 82 Broadway Stores Inc. stores acquired by Federated last year, while total sales for November 1996 reflect only the revenues from those Broadway store properties that subsequently were converted to Federated nameplates - 56 stores as of November 30.

Allen Questrom, chairman and chief executive, said the company was pleased with its strong November sales. Questrom cautioned, however, that because of how the retail calendar falls this year, "we need to wait to evaluate November and December together, which should reflect far more modest increases than we saw in November alone."

For the year to date, Federated reported total sales of $11,746.3 million, an increase of 4.1 percent over sales of $11,279.0 million in the same 43-week period last year. On a comparable-store basis, year-to-date sales increased 3.5 percent.
